title: Lore-Forge entry front matter, schema version 1
description: YAML front matter of one entry file (<typeFolder>/<id>.md). The Markdown body follows the closing ---. Unknown keys are allowed and preserved.

date.description: [~]DATE [ERA], or unknown / ?. DATE is YYYY, MM.YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY, DD.MM (day and month, year unknown) or the older YYYY-MM / YYYY-MM-DD. In MM.YYYY the year needs 3+ digits (0050), a minus sign or an era code; otherwise two numbers are DD.MM. ~ = approximate.

type.description: Usually a type from the relation table (RELATION_KINDS in @lore-forge/core); custom types are allowed.

tags.description: Old free-form labels. Still read, kept when the file is saved, searchable in the sidebar and listed in the World Codex; the editor no longer shows them.

race.description: Character only: race or kind, free text (human, camel-folk, ghoul, vampire...). Several are comma-separated ("elf, human"); a list is read the same way. Each links to an entry when one has this id or name.

status.description: character: alive/dead/unknown; place: standing/destroyed/unknown; faction: active/dissolved/unknown; item: intact/destroyed/lost/unknown. A missing status means unknown. An ongoing status hides the end date in the editor; the value stays in the file.

visual.description: Free-text visual description for art. Usual keys: character appearance/build/clothing/palette/features/props; place architecture/climate/palette/scale; faction emblem/attire/palette; item material/size/details; event scene/mood. Other keys allowed.

picture.description: Card picture set on the Home page: a game-icons.net icon name, background and accent colours, or an image file (relative to the world folder, also listed in images). Missing parts use the defaults.

looks.description: Other looks of the entry over time, besides the Default one (the entry itself): why it looks different, when (dates, an era, after or before an event; any mix narrows it), and the visual description fields that change. Pictures name their look in images[].look; 3D models of a look live in models/<entryId>/<lookId>/.

id.description: Stable id, kept when the look is renamed; made from the name when missing.

reason.description: Why it looks different: a wound, a new title, new clothes.

from.description: Date in the world calendar (DD.MM.YYYY, MM.YYYY or YYYY, optional ~ and era code).

era.description: Era id: the look applies while that era lasts.

after.description: Event (or another entry with a date), by id or name: the look applies from its end on.

before.description: Event (or another entry with a date), by id or name: the look applies until it starts.

visual.description: Visual description fields that differ from the Default look.

chapter.description: Story Book chapter title override (events and notes).

bookOrder.description: Story Book order inside the chapter; default 0, lower first, ties by date then name.

images.description: Reference images, on any entry type.

file.description: Path relative to the world folder, normally images/<entryId>/<file>.

look.description: Id of the entry's look (in looks) this picture shows; without it, the Default look.

view.description: Kebab-case view label. Usual views per type: character a-pose/front/back/left/right/three-quarter/concept; place establishing/map/interior/exterior/mood/concept; faction emblem/banner/uniform/headquarters/concept; item front/back/side/top/detail/concept; event scene/establishing/map/mood/concept; note illustration/map/concept. Others are allowed (info warning image-view).

gender.description: Character: free text, e.g. female, male, non-binary. Also picks the default picture.

title.description: Character: title or rank, e.g. King, Lady.

affiliations.description: Character: factions they belong to (counts as member-of).

kind.description: Place, faction, item or event: what sort it is (castle, guild, sword, battle...). Also picks the default picture.

ruler.description: Place: who rules it (counts as <ruler> rules <place>).

origin.description: Item: who made it or where it comes from.

location.description: Item: where it is now (counts as located-in).

owners.description: Item: owners over time (each counts as <owner> owns <item>).
